content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "She intends to attend an evening theatre performance in autumn, and while her standard attire level is home, the occasion of a full evening play demands a step up to smart or neat formal wear to respect the venue's ambiance. She explicitly requests blue shoes and refuses any items that contradict this wish or the evening setting, so we will select a refined knit top paired with tailored trousers to bridge casual comfort with theatrical elegance. The outfit includes a textured jacket for an extra layer of polish suitable for autumn evenings, complemented by her chosen azure pumps that catch the artificial stage lighting beautifully. This ensemble works because it elevates her home-style preference into a sophisticated look perfect for an evening in the theatre without sacrificing her desire for blue footwear.\nSemi-sheer silk blouse, relaxed fit, hip-length cut, navy blue (#001f3f), lightweight woven fabric; Tailored wool-blend trousers, straight leg, ankle-length cut, charcoal grey (#36454F), structured worsted wool; Oversized textured wool jacket, boxy cut, hip-length hem, deep forest green (#228B22), heavy gauge knit fabric; Blue suede pumps, pointed toe, mid-heel height, vibrant cobalt blue (#0047AB), soft napped suede."}
